info.title: Thenwise team server
info.description: API v1, frozen for the Hub. Every route but health, session and join takes `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or the tw_session cookie; writes with a cookie also send X-Thenwise-CSRF equal to the tw_csrf cookie. Errors are { error: { code, message } }. Roles, lowest to highest: viewer, member, editor, admin, owner; a refused call is 403 forbidden and is audited.

get.summary: Liveness, schema version and the team's name.

post.summary: Signs in with a token. Sets the cookies tw_session (httpOnly) and tw_csrf; writes from a session send tw_csrf's value in X-Thenwise-CSRF.

delete.summary: Signs out and clears the cookies.

post.summary: Joins with an invite code and a name. Answers with the token, shown once; with `session: true` or Accept: text/html the cookies are set too.

get.summary: The member the token or session belongs to.
Full-text search over shared notes, best match first, with a snippet around the hit.
Shared notes: newest first, or with since, every note changed after that revision in revision order (never a pending note).

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Each note with its text instead of a snippet.

get.summary: One shared note in full. A read from a session is counted.

patch.summary: Edits a note. If-Match is the revision read. Writes a revision. Needs the editor role.

get.summary: Every revision of a note, newest first, with its text.

post.summary: Marks a note retired. Needs the editor role.
Marks a note superseded by another shared note (`by` is its id for the same owner, or owner/id). Needs the editor role.
Pins a note. Needs the editor role.
Unpins a note. Needs the editor role.
Makes a pending note active (review queue). Needs the admin role.

put.summary: Shares a note or a new version of it. If-Match is the revision last seen, or * for a note new to the team. kind, source and tags are optional. Needs the member role.

delete.summary: Unshares a note. A tomb records it for the feeds; its revisions and counts go. Needs the member role.

get.summary: Unshares after a revision, in revision order.
Everyone on the team. Needs the admin role.

patch.summary: Changes a member's role, expiry or disabled flag. The owner cannot be changed. Needs the admin role.

delete.summary: Removes a member, keeping or deleting their notes. The owner cannot be removed. Needs the admin role.

post.summary: Gives a member a new token, shown once. The old token and sessions stop at once. Needs the admin role.
Hands the team over to another live member; the caller becomes an admin. Needs the owner role.

get.summary: The team's settings. Needs the admin role.

patch.summary: Changes the team's name or the review queue. Needs the admin role.

post.summary: Creates an invite code, shown once. Needs the admin role.

get.summary: The audit log, newest first. Needs the admin role.
Most-read notes and last seen, counts over the last 90 days. Nothing leaves the server. Needs the admin role.
A zip of Markdown files in the vault format (one per note, an Index.md per project). Needs the editor role.

put.summary: Shares a chat or a new version of it, replacing its passages in one step. If-Match is the revision last seen, or * for a chat new to the team. Needs the member role. 400 names the field when the unit holds an absolute path, a cwd, more than 2000 passages or 2 MB; 413 quota above 200 MB per member.

delete.summary: Unshares a chat: passages, search entries and read counts go, a tomb stays. Needs the member role.

get.summary: Chats of other members in revision order. Metadata and turn counts only, or with full=1 every turn and passage. since is the last revision seen. Any role.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: 1 adds turns and passages. Default: metadata only.

get.summary: Chats that match q, best passage first, one row per chat, with a snippet. For the Hub; any role.
One chat in full. A read through a browser session is counted and audited. Any role.

delete.summary: An admin unshares a member's chat (a member's own goes through the one-segment path). Audited as chat.admin_unshare. Needs the admin role.

get.summary: Chats unshared after a revision, in revision order.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: only: just the caller's own tombs.

get.summary: Which member shares which project: chat count, bytes and last push. No text. Any role.

delete.summary: Unshares every chat of a project of a member, with tombs. The member or an admin.

patch.summary: Sets a project's status to paused or active (the owner's client calls this on pause and resume). The member or an admin.

get.summary: The team's chat settings. Needs the admin role.

patch.summary: Sets chat_retention_days: the daily sweep deletes chats that ended earlier, with tombs. null keeps chats until their owners unshare. Needs the admin role.

NoteBrief.description: A note in a list: a snippet, or its text with full=1.

dead_text.description: The sentence that says what failed. Optional.

reshare.description: True when the owner deliberately shares again: undoes a tomb made on the server (admin, Hub, retention). Without it such a PUT answers 409 unshared.

dead_text.description: The sentence that says what failed. Optional.
